question.prompt: How many square yards of carpet are required to cover a rectangular floor that is \(12\) feet long and \(9\) feet wide? (There are \(3\) feet in a yard.)

solutions.explanation:
Convert both dimensions to yards so their product will be in square yards. Since \(3\) feet make \(1\) yard, the floor is \(12\div3=4\) yards long and \(9\div3=3\) yards wide. A rectangle's area is length times width, so the carpet required is
\[
4\cdot3=\boxed{12}\text{ square yards},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
solutions.title: Convert the dimensions to yards
